sn47.33:1.1: “Bhikkhus, those who have neglected these four establishments of mindfulness have neglected the noble path leading to the complete destruction of suffering.
sn47.33:1.2: Those who have undertaken these four establishments of mindfulness have undertaken the noble path leading to the complete destruction of suffering.
sn47.33:2.7: Those who have undertaken these four establishments of mindfulness have undertaken the noble path leading to the complete destruction of suffering.”
